Module org.slb4j
Package org.slb4j.support

Interface TimeStampFormatter

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractTimeStampFormatter, ISO8601TimeStampFormatter, MillisTimeStampFormatter, PatternTimeStampFormatter, TimeOnlyTimeStampFormatter
public interface TimeStampFormatter
Defines a contract for formatting timestamps represented as epoch milliseconds into human-readable string representations or appending them to an output target. This interface provides both performance-optimized and debug-friendly methods for working with timestamp data.

  • Method Details

    • appendTo

      void appendTo(long timestamp, Appendable app) throws IOException
      Appends a formatted representation of the given timestamp to the provided Appendable. The timestamp is expected to be in epoch milliseconds, and it is formatted based on the internal configuration of the implementing formatter.
      Parameters:
      timestamp - the epoch timestamp in milliseconds to be formatted and appended.
      app - the Appendable to which the formatted timestamp will be written.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs while appending to the Appendable.

    • toString

      default String toString(long timestamp)
      Converts the given timestamp to its corresponding string representation. The method formats the timestamp using a builder-like approach, relying on internally configured components such as pre-defined formatting rules and time zone or offset settings.

      This method is intended for debugging purposes only (it is not garbage-free, i.e., when used for logging might create a bottleneck).

      Parameters:
      timestamp - the epoch timestamp in milliseconds that is to be formatted into a string representation. It is interpreted based on the configured time zone and offsets.
      Returns:
      the string representation of the provided timestamp, formatted according to the internal configuration of this formatter.
      Throws:
      UncheckedIOException - if an I/O error occurs while constructing the formatted string.
